statement: In a torsion-free full profinite finite extension of a free group of rank r>=2, the quotient order divides r-1. Rank two has no proper torsion-free extension. Every prime-order outer action on Fhat_2 lifts to a genuine finite-order automorphism, with its prescribed labels.
where_proved: Paper D.27; complete maximal pro-p quotient and Schreier argument
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan353: comme|connu; sans torsion inserted; tte doubtful. The tested extension is explicitly torsion-free.
notes: Original1982 scan pp496–498 opened and visually read. The full rank-divisibility argument is written out; prime-order lift existence is derived from the exact pullback and torsion-free kernel. No conjugacy or full GT0 torsion classification is inferred.
